definitions.full: H7546. raqqach [ רַקָּח ] noun masculine ointment-maker, perfumer ; — only in phrase בֶּןהָֿרַקָּחִים Neh 3:8 , i.e. one of the perfumers, i.e. of that guild.

occurrences.englishText: Next to him, Uzziel the son of Harhaiah, goldsmiths, made repairs. Next to him, Hananiah, one of the perfumers, made repairs, and they fortified Jerusalem even to the wide wall.
